hero.body: I design practical AI, automation, digital operations, local-first tools, and implementation resources for people who want work that survives contact with reality.

resources.headline: See the standard. Buy the operating depth.
resources.supportingCopy: I publish public orientation notes that explain the problem space and my operating position. Reusable methods, prompts, blueprints, templates, decision logic, and implementation detail remain inside paid releases or private engagements.

articles.title: AI without the noise
articles.description: AI is useful when the job, evidence boundary, authority, and expected result are clear. This note defines the territory without publishing the reusable operating method.

sections.heading: Public orientation
paragraphs: AI is useful when the job, evidence boundary, authority, and expected result are clear. This note defines the territory without publishing the reusable operating method.

CrossingKey public documentation is intentionally descriptive rather than reconstructive. It shows what I value and what a buyer can expect without transferring the method, private architecture, or reusable implementation assets.

takeaways: Get the implementation system in the Operator Vault.
